title: GSX-R1000R Superbike
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Suzuki GSX-R1000R Superbike is born on the race grid to deliver uncompromised high-speed aerodynamic downforce. At its heart lies a 1000cc powertrain delivering 150 HP and 120 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 230 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, backed by a 19.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
